That's who we're looking for.



We're a content and brand production company covering fitness, lifestyle, and branded storytelling. The pace is fast, the standards are high, and the work is the kind you'll actually want in your reel.

20+ edits per month across short and long-form content. 48-hour turnaround on short-form, 5 days on long-form. Full project workflow through Notion. Weekly creative sync.



What great looks like here:

Dynamic, rhythm-driven editing — colour grading, sound design, motion graphics. A storytelling instinct that knows when to cut and when to breathe. Bonus if you understand comedic timing.



What we offer:

Consistent volume, performance-based rate increases, viral bonuses when your edits blow up, and a real path to full-time for the right person.

What do you edit best — and what's a project you're proud of?

Share your portfolio. Point us to something close to fitness, lifestyle, or branded content.

Have you held a 48h turnaround consistently? Give us a real example.

How do you handle direct, specific revision notes?

What did you spot on social this week that made you think someone should make that?

Open to a paid test edit?

description:
We're a growing U.S.-based digital marketing and AI agency looking for an experienced tea
mber who wants to grow with us long-term.



We're not looking for a typical virtual assistant. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with clients, and taking ownership of projects.

* Set up new client accounts

* Help organize content and marketing assets

* Identify content pillars and target audiences

* Meta 
 & Instagram) Ads

* GoHighLevel

* AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)

We're looking for someone who:

Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

Job Description:

Read this before you apply. This is not a normal EA role.



Most executive assistant jobs treat you like a task machine. Plug data into a sheet. Wait to be told what to do. No growth, no ownership, no reason to care.



If that's what you're looking for, close this tab now.



I'm looking for one person to essentially become my right hand — someone who executes everything I currently do myself, so that I can focus on strategy while you run the operations. Reporting, funnels, ads, automations, managing the team, finding leads, fixing problems before I even see them. Over time, the goal is for you to do everything I do.



This is a long-term role. The person who's an A+ fit will be here for years and grow into a high-level partner in this business. I care about this company more than anything and I put my all into it — I need someone who matches that energy. Someone who treats this work like it's their own, beats me to the punch, and makes me feel like I need to work harder just to keep up with them.



You must be:

- 3+ years experience as an EA/VA — NOT a beginner. You help me manage; I don't manage you.

- An EXPERT in GoHighLevel, Claude Code OR Codex (you use AI every single day)

- Highly confident in Meta Ads Manager 

- Comfortable with Make / Zapier

- Familiar with Slack and ClickUp

- Perfect written and spoken English

- Available 40 hours/week on US hours



Bonus (not required, but amazing): Vercel, Supabase, GitHub with Claude/Codex.

You're hungry and looking to prove yourself. You want to own your work and go above and beyond because you actually care. You have a brain and you use it; you're not a yes-sir/no-sir order-taker. You want to grind. Overtime isn't a burden to you, it's a sign you're building something. You've never found a role you could truly pour yourself into — and you're looking for the one that finally fits.

title: US Mortgage & Commercial Loan Processing VA | Loan Officer Assistant
description:
Job Title: US Mortgage & Commercial Loan Processing VA | Loan Officer Assistant 



Job Description:

We are a growing commercial loan brokerage based in New York City,  USA looking for an experienced or ambitious Loan Processing Virtual Assistant or Loan Officer Assistant with direct US mortgage or commercial lending experience.

This is a long-term, full-time remote position. We broker commercial loans including DSCR, bridge, hard money, and construction loans for US-based real estate investors and business owners. We need someone who is detail-obsessed, follows up relentlessly, and treats every loan file with accuracy and professionalism.



What You Will Do:

Loan Processing and File Management:



Borrower intake — collecting applications, documents, and supporting materials

Pipeline tracking — maintaining accurate and up-to-date loan file status

Document review — verifying completeness and accuracy of income docs, bank statements, credit reports, appraisals, rent rolls, and entity documents

Condition clearing — tracking outstanding lender conditions and chasing borrowers and third parties for outstanding items

File organization — maintaining audit-ready, organized loan files at all times

Initial disclosure support and lender submission coordination



Lender and Borrower Communication:



Professional written communication with US lenders and borrowers

Follow-up
s and calls on outstanding documents and conditions

Lender portal navigation and submission support

Coordinating with title companies, appraisers, and attorneys as needed



Commercial Loan Products:



Supporting DSCR loan files — rent rolls, lease agreements, property financials

Supporting bridge loan files — exit strategies, property valuations, draw schedules

Supporting construction loan files — draw requests, inspection coordination, budgets

Supporting hard money files — asset documentation and property analysis



CRM and Pipeline Management:



Maintaining accurate pipeline data in CRM

Daily status updates on all active files

Reporting on pipeline volume and file status to ownership



You Are a Strong Fit If You Have:



2+ years of US residential or commercial mortgage experience — you have processed real loan files

Experience reviewing income documentation — W2, 1040, paystubs, bank statements, rent rolls, business returns

Strong written English — you will communicate professionally with US lenders and borrowers daily

High attention to detail and accuracy — errors in loan files have real consequences

Ability to work ET or EST-adjacent hours

Reliable internet — minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload





Strongly Preferred:



Strong English skills

Good DISC Personality Test

Experience with DSCR, bridge, hard money, or construction loans

Experience working directly with a US mortgage broker

Knowledge of commercial real estate lending guidelines

Experience with title, appraisal, and closing coordination





To Apply, Please Send:



Your resume (PDF preferred)

A brief introduction — tell me why you shoule be chosen in 1 sentence. Generic introductions will not be reviewed.

Your internet speed test result (
 or speedtest.net) — minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload required

Answer this question in detail: Walk me through a loan file you have worked on recently — from intake to where it stands today or how it closed. Be as specific as possible about your role, the lender, the loan type, and the conditions you cleared. (only want 5 sentences max, be consise and to the point)



Applications without all four items will not be reviewed.



Why Join Us:



Ground floor opportunity — you help build the systems and processes of a growing brokerage

Direct access to the owner — no corporate layers, no bureaucracy

Long-term stable position with performance-based growth

Competitive rate for qualified candidates with real experience

Work on diverse commercial loan products across the US market

13th Month and holiday pay

Bonus and commission pay

title: Funding & Growth Assistant
description:
We are expanding our team and seeking a Funding & Growth Assistant to help clients move beyond credit repair into credit building, funding readiness, and long-term financial success.



This role focuses on client success, follow-up, credit strategy support, and helping clients progress through each stage of their financial journey from credit improvement to funding opportunities.



 Role Overview



The Funding & Growth Assistant will work directly with clients after credit repair to ensure they remain engaged, informed, and actively progressing toward their financial goals.



This role helps guide clients through:

Credit Repair ? Credit Building ? Funding Readiness ? Financial Growth Opportunities



Key Responsibilities



* Track and manage client progress throughout each stage of the program

* Conduct consistent follow-ups to ensure clients stay active and engaged

* Review client credit progress and identify next-step opportunities

* Assist in developing personalized credit building and funding readiness strategies

* Provide guidance on improving credit profiles for score growth and approval readiness

* Support clients in understanding personal and business funding pathways

* Be knowledgeable in **credit building strategies including primary tradelines and authorized user tradelines**

* Assist in applying credit profile enhancement strategies to help clients strengthen their reports

* Transition clients into the appropriate next service (credit building or funding preparation)

* Maintain accurate client records and updates in CRM systems

* Identify satisfied clients and introduce referral and testimonial opportunities

* Help improve client retention and reduce drop-off between program stages



 Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has experience in credit repair, credit building, lending, or financial services

* Understands U.S. credit reporting systems and scoring factors

* Has knowledge of primary trade lines and authorized user trade lines and how they are used in credit building strategies

* Can confidently communicate credit concepts in a simple, client-friendly way

* Is proactive, organized, and detail-oriented

* Has strong follow-up and client success skills

* Has experience in funding, lending, or business credit (preferred but not required)



What We Offer



* Training on our internal systems and client journey

* Opportunity to grow with a fast-scaling financial services company

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

description:

About ECSAT



ECSAT builds high-performing remote sales organizations for growing companies across North America. We combine proven sales processes, technology, and exceptional talent to help our partners scale while creating meaningful career opportunities for our tea
mbers.



We believe performance should create opportunity. As we grow, we are committed to promoting from within and developing future leaders.



The Opportunity



We are hiring five Founding Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to launch a new U.S. roofing campaign.



This is more than a sales position—it is an opportunity to become part of the team that builds this operation from the ground up.



Our objective is to successfully complete this pilot program and rapidly expand the campaign to more than 150 SDRs. The professionals who join us first will have the greatest opportunity to advance into Team Lead, Training, Quality Assurance, Operations, and Management positions as the organization grows.



If you're looking for a company where your performance directly impacts your career progression, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do



As an SDR, you will be responsible for managing the customer journey from the initial conversation through the sales process.



Your responsibilities include:



Contact homeowners in the United States regarding potential roof damage identified through professional drone inspections.

Explain the inspection process and answer homeowner questions.

Request permission to send drone images of their roof via SMS.

Schedule complimentary, no-obligation roof inspections.

Maintain accurate CRM records and activity logs.

Follow up with homeowners after inspections.

Support the sales process through project close.

Consistently achieve daily activity and performance goals.



Unlike traditional cold calling, homeowners will have already received information by mail regarding their property's inspection, making conversations significantly warmer and more consultative.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Minimum of two years of outbound sales, SDR, or appointment-setting experience.

Strong spoken English with clear and professional communication.

Ability to thrive in a high-volume outbound calling environment.

Coachable, resilient, and performance driven.

Roofing or home services experience.

Insurance restoration experience.

CRM experience.

Previous experience selling into the U.S. market.

Performance Expectations



Successful SDRs can expect to:



Average approximately 40 outbound calls per hour.

Maintain detailed and accurate CRM documentation.

Schedule qualified roof inspections.

Conduct timely customer follow-up.

Contribute toward approximately 40 closed roofing projects per month.

Deliver an outstanding customer experience throughout the sales cycle.



Training, coaching, and ongoing development will be provided.



Compensation

Base Compensation: USD $500 per month.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): Up to USD $3,000+ per month through tiered, uncapped commissions.

Monthly payments issued on the 5th of each month.

Base salary is prorated for employees who begin mid-month.



Commission details will be discussed during the interview process.



Employment Details

Independent Contractor during the initial six-month onboarding period.

Full-time schedule (40 hours per week).

Monday through Friday.

Working hours approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM based on the assigned U.S. market.

Remote position open to qualified candidates worldwide.



Outstanding performers who successfully complete the initial contractor period will be considered for full-time employment with enhanced compensation and additional benefits as the campaign expands.



Equipment Requirements



Applicants must have:



Reliable computer or laptop.

High-speed internet connection (wired preferred).

Professional USB headset.

Quiet home office suitable for client calls.

Webcam for meetings and training.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review

Initial Screening Interview

English Communication Assessment

Sales Role Play

Final Interview

Offer & Onboarding



Our goal is to provide timely communication throughout the hiring process.



Applicant Privacy



Information submitted during the recruitment process will be used solely for evaluating your application and communicating with you regarding employment opportunities with ECSAT. Applicant information will not be sold or shared with third parties except as required to support the recruitment process or comply with applicable laws.



Join Our Founding Team



We are only hiring five SDRs for this initial launch.



Even if all current openings are filled, we encourage qualified professionals to apply. As the campaign grows, we expect to expand rapidly and will first consider candidates already in our recruitment pipeline.



If you're ready to build something meaningful, grow your career, and be rewarded for your performance, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Photo & Video Designer (Remote)
description:
Work directly with an international client, no Philippine agency, no middleman.



We're looking for someone who goes beyond prompting AI. If you're the type of designer who notices when a shadow is wrong, a hand looks unnatural, or a product feature is inconsistent across images, we'd love to hear from you.

Our goal isn't simply to generate AI images, it's to create visuals that are indistinguishable from real commercial photography.



Responsibilities

Generate high-quality lifestyle images and short-form videos using ChatGPT, Gemini, Higgsfield, and similar AI tools.

Refine AI-generated assets in Adobe Photoshop to achieve production-ready quality.

Execute creative briefs accurately, including scene, composition, camera angle, lighting, styling, subject interaction, and overall mood.

Perform detailed self-QA before submission and resolve issues proactively.

Revise assets based on our feedback.



What We Expect

We're looking for someone with a strong eye for realism, consistency, and product fidelity, not just someone who can write prompts.

A big part of this role is ensuring that every lifestyle image and video remains 100% true to the actual product. You should be able to accurately maintain:

Product shape, size, and proportions

Colors, materials, and textures

Logos, branding, and graphic placement

Product-specific features, accessories, and details

Consistency across every image and video frame



You should also be able to identify and fix:

AI artifacts and hallucinations

Warped hands, faces, anatomy, or object geometry

Unrealistic lighting, reflections, shadows, and perspective

Texture inconsistencies across products, skin, clothing, fabrics, water, and other materials

Flickering or morphing elements in videos

Missing or inconsistent product details between scenes

Unrealistic interactions between people, products, and the environment

Visuals that don't fully match the creative brief



You should naturally ask yourself:

Does this actually look like a real photograph?

Does the product match the reference exactly?

Are all visible product details consistent across every image and frame?

Would this pass as a real commercial photoshoot?



Requirements

Experience using ChatGPT, Gemini, Higgsfield, or similar AI generation tools.

Strong Adobe Photoshop skills for retouching, compositing, and AI cleanup.

Excellent understanding of composition, lighting, color, and commercial-quality imagery.

High attention to detail and willingness to iterate until the work is client-ready.

title: Full-Time UGC Manager — Creator Acquisition & Management for Premium Skincare Brand (DTC/Ecommerce)
description:
About Us:



VEAUTY is a fast-growing premium skincare technology brand selling direct-to-consumer through our Shopify store. Our hero product, the VEAUTY Dot, is the world's only true home fractional RF device — used by 56,000+ customers and trusted by 150+ professional clinics worldwide. We're scaling our content engine aggressively and need a dedicated UGC Manager to build and manage a constant pipeline of creators producing authentic, high-converting content for our brand.



The Role:



We're looking for a full-time, dedicated UGC Manager who can find, recruit, negotiate with, and manage UGC creators at scale. Your job is to keep a steady stream of fresh, authentic video and photo content flowing into our creative team — content that our video editors will then turn into high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

This isn't a "post on social media" role. This is a sourcing, outreach, negotiation, and project management role. You'll be the bridge between creators and our brand — ensuring we always have new faces, new angles, and new content to fuel our advertising. You'll work closely with our marketing manager on scripts, creative direction, hooks, and content style to ensure every piece of UGC aligns with what's working in our ads.



What You'll Do:



You'll source and recruit new UGC creators on an ongoing basis — our preferred model is gifted partnerships (sending free product in exchange for content), though you'll also manage paid creators when needed. You'll build and maintain a pipeline of active creators so we never run dry on fresh content. You'll handle all communication with creators — outreach, onboarding, briefing, follow-ups, and feedback. You'll write and send detailed creator briefs that include scripts, hooks, visual direction, dos and don'ts, and example videos so creators know exactly what we need. You'll coordinate with our marketing manager to align all briefs with current ad strategy, winning hooks, and performance data. You'll manage delivery timelines and hold creators accountable — ensuring content arrives on time and meets our quality standards. You'll provide constructive feedback when content doesn't match the brief, and manage revision requests without burning creator relationships. You'll negotiate fair rates with paid creators, always balancing quality with budget efficiency. You'll track everything — creator contacts, outreach status, delivery dates, content received, and performance — in an organized system.



What We Need From You:



You must have 1+ years of experience sourcing and managing UGC creators or influencer partnerships for ecommerce or DTC brands. You need proven experience with gifted/seeding campaigns — convincing creators to produce content in exchange for free product is a core skill for this role. You should be comfortable with cold outreach via DM and
, with a track record of getting responses and building creator relationships.



You must be highly organized — managing 10–30+ active creators simultaneously requires tight systems, follow-up discipline, and attention to detail. You need strong written communication skills — your outreach messages, briefs, and follow-ups need to be clear, professional, and persuasive.



You should understand what makes great UGC for direct-response advertising — this isn't about pretty content, it's about authentic content that converts. You need to know the difference between content that looks good on a feed and content that stops the scroll in a paid ad. Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and the broader creator landscape is essential. Experience using platforms like Billo, Insense, JoinBrands, or similar UGC marketplaces is a plus. Experience in the skincare, beauty, or health/wellness niche is a strong advantage.



What Success Looks Like:



In your first month, you'll have sourced and onboarded your first batch of creators, established your outreach and tracking systems, and delivered your first round of UGC content to our editing team. By month two, you'll have a steady pipeline producing new content weekly, with a mix of gifted and paid creators. By month three, you'll be proactively identifying creator styles and content angles that align with our best-performing ads — bringing ideas to the table, not just filling orders.

Our best UGC managers don't just find creators — they build relationships, understand what content drives results, and become the engine that keeps our creative team fed with fresh material.

This is a full-time, exclusive role at $750 USD/month. You will not be permitted to work for any other brands or clients while employed with us — we need your full focus and commitment. , platforms, and communities, with a focus on gifted/seeding partnerships.

Prescare Nursing & Healthcare Staffing

Start Date: As soon as possible.



Remote – Must be available during Atlantic Time working hours (e.g., 9am–1pm AT, Monday to Friday)



Why this role is a real opportunity



This is a long-term position with a growing Canadian healthcare company. The right person will have direct access to leadership, genuine ownership of the brand's digital voice, and a clear path to full-time hours as Prescare scales. We pay based on what you bring, not a fixed ceiling.



Be clear-eyed about what you're walking into



Prescare's social media is in early stages — a small following and very few posts so far. This isn't a role to manage an existing presence. It's a role to build one from the ground up for a business that's growing fast. If building something from scratch excites you, this is the right role.



Who we are



Prescare Nursing & Healthcare Staffing is a trusted provider of culturally respectful and client-focused nursing services in the Canadian provinces of Manitoba and New Brunswick. We currently support long-term care facilities and hospitals in Manitoba and are expanding into homecare services in New Brunswick and Winnipeg. In the home care aspect of the company, we serve families, seniors, and healthcare organizations across Manitoba and New Brunswick.



We provide three core services:



Home care — supporting seniors, individuals with disabilities, post-surgery recovery patients, new mothers, and palliative care families in both provinces

Healthcare staffing — placing nurses (RNs, RPNs, LPNs), and healthcare aides (HCAs) with hospitals and long-term care facilities in Manitoba

Residential cleaning — professional home cleaning services across Manitoba and New Brunswick

We are owner-operated, people-first, and known for being responsive, professional, and genuinely caring toward both clients and staff. As we grow, our mission remains the same: to provide dignified, family-centred care to those who need it most. We’re now looking for a creative, reliable, and tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Social Media Lead — Healthcare & Home Care to support our sales and marketing efforts while amplifying our presence across digital platforms.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



The core challenge: two audiences, one brand



This is the most important thing to understand about this role. Prescare's content must speak to two very different groups at the same time:



Families & clients — seniors, adult children arranging care for a parent, new mothers, individuals navigating illness or disability. They need warmth, clarity, and trust — not sales language.



Healthcare professionals — nurses and healthcare aides in Manitoba evaluating staffing agencies. They need to see professionalism, reliability, and a team that respects their work.

title: WordPress + Elementor Web Designer
description:
# WordPress + Elementor Web Designer (Conversion-Focused, Trades / Local Service) — Part-Time, Long-Term



**Read this whole post before applying. Applications that skip the steps at the bottom will be ignored.**



## About the role



We run two established Australian trade businesses: an electrical services company and a security installation company (CCTV, alarms, intercoms, access control). Both are licensed, insured, and well-reviewed, and both need to convert website visitors and Google Ads clicks into phone calls and form leads.



We are looking for a WordPress and Elementor designer to work with us **long-term on an ongoing retainer**. One designer will handle both brands. You will not be building pretty portfolio sites. You will be building lead machines that load fast, look clean, and convert.



You will work directly with the business owner and the SEO and Google Ads specialist. Clear briefs and fast feedback are part of how we operate.



## What you will do



- Design and build conversion-focused pages in WordPress with Elementor

- Build landing pages for Google Ads campaigns that improve conversions and Quality Score

- Create and improve service pages and suburb pages for local SEO

- Keep everything mobile-first, since most of our traffic is on phones

- Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)

- Place calls to action, click-to-call, forms, and trust signals where they convert

- Test forms, links, and tracking before anything goes live

- Keep both brands visually consistent using the brand kits we provide



## What we are looking for (must-have)



- 5+ years building WordPress sites with Elementor, with **live examples you can show us**

- Real conversion-focused design: CTA placement, trust signals, clean section flow, mobile-first

- Strong page speed discipline (image compression, lightweight builds, no slider bloat)

- Solid understanding of local SEO page structure (service pages, city or suburb pages, headings, internal links, FAQs)

- Clear written English and reliable with deadlines

- Comfortable following clear briefs and working section by section with an owner, SEO, and Ads specialist



## Big bonus (this moves you to the top of the pile)



- Experience with **trades or home service businesses**: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, security, locksmiths, builders

- Experience building **Google Ads landing pages** and understanding message match and Quality Score

- Core Web Vitals and performance tuning experience

- GA4 and Google Tag Manager, or comfort embedding tracking and testing it

- Comfortable using AI tools to work faster (CSS snippets, troubleshooting, drafts) and validating the output before publishing

- Basic HTML and CSS for small adjustments without leaning on plugins



## Tools you will use



WordPress, Elementor Pro, a lightweight theme (Hello or Astra), GA4, GTM, PageSpeed Insights, and a form and tracking setup we will share. Figma or Canva for mockups is a plus.



## Schedule and pay



- Part-time, ongoing retainer with consistent weekly work

- Timezone overlap with Sydney, Australia is required (we are 2 to 3 hours ahead of Philippine time, so this is an easy overlap)

- Probationary rate for the first 30 to 60 days, then an increase based on performance and speed

- Paid regularly via Wise or Payoneer

- No upfront or advance payments. A short **paid test** is required for final candidates before we commit.



This is a long-term role for the right person. We would rather train and keep one reliable designer than churn through many.



## How to apply



Start your message with the word **VOLTAGE** so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be opened.



Then send:



1. **2 to 3 live Elementor sites you built** (links, not screenshots). Trades or local service examples preferred.

2. Your **monthly rate expectation** for part-time ongoing work, and your **weekly availability and timezone**.

3. Short answers to these:

   - What are the top 5 things you do to keep an Elementor site fast?

   - What is different about a landing page built for Google Ads versus a normal service page?

   - Have you built service or suburb pages for local SEO before? Give one example.

   - Are you comfortable embedding forms and checking that tracking fires correctly?

4. A 1 to 2 minute Loom or video intro is preferred but not required.



We reply to applicants who follow these steps. We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Shopify Developer
description:
Remote | $15-25/hour



About Premium Invention

We're a profitable DTC brand selling premium solar-powered security cameras to off-grid customers across North America — ranchers, cabin owners, farmers, construction sites. We sell directly to consumers through Shopify Plus. We're launching multiple new products in 2026 and need a developer who can keep our storefronts fast, tested, and converting.



What You'll Actually Do:

Our Shopify Plus setup spans four subdomains (US, Canada, UK, Australia) with ongoing CRO tests, product launches, and  

checkout optimization. Day-to-day, you'll be:

- Building and iterating on landing pages for new product launches

- Implementing CRO tweaks from our Head of Growth and Product Marketing team (A/B tests, new sections, trust elements, comparison tables)

- Debugging and fixing issues across all four regional storefronts

- Managing DNS, subdomains, and domain configurations

- Optimizing site speed — we lose revenue every time a page crawls

- Checkout customization within Shopify Plus Scripts and Functions

- Using Claude Code / Cursor to move faster, not as a crutch

- You'll work closely with our marketing team under the Head of Growth. You're not just taking tickets — you're flagging what's broken, suggesting better implementations, and pushing back when something won't work.



Must-Have:

3+ years professional development experience with Shopify Plus specifically (not just basic Shopify)

Hands-on with Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you write this code yourself, not just direct others

DNS and domain management — you've set up and debugged subdomains before

Clear written and spoken English — team coordination happens over Zoom

Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) — we work fast and expect you to leverage these



Nice to Have:

Experience with Shopify Plus Scripts and Shopify Functions

Built custom checkout experiences on Plus

Worked on DTC brands selling physical products (not just agency work)

Familiar with tools like Hotjar, GA4, Google Tag Manager

Experience with multi-region / multi-currency Shopify Plus setups



Not For You If:

Your Shopify experience is only Basic/Advanced Shopify, not Plus

Your experience is limited to Shopify theme customization without backend or Plus-specific work

You need detailed specs for every task and can't work from a brief

You're looking for a full-time salaried role right now (this starts part-time)

You're uncomfortable being tracked via Hubstaff while actively working

AI coding tools aren't already part of your daily workflow



How to Apply

We do not accept applications through OnlineJobs.ph messaging. To be considered, please complete our application form here:



The form takes 20-25 minutes and includes a required Loom video — strong candidates will be invited to an interview within 24 hours.

title: Real Estate Sales Rep (Part-Time / Immediate Start)
description:
Duration: 1-Week Trial (with long-term potential based on performance) | Start Date: IMMEDIATE



We are seeking a reliable, fluent English speaker for a quick, 1-week part-time trial project starting immediately. This is a very simple, low-stress position. You do not need to do any data entry, you do not need access to our CRM, and you do not need to do any hard selling. The dialer does all the heavy lifting, you just sit on the line, wait for someone to answer, and read a short script.



How to Apply: Send a brief voice recording (Vocaroo link) introducing yourself. Applications without voice notes will NOT be considered.



Key Responsibilities:



- Work a 4-hour shift from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST (Monday - Friday).

- Log into our automated phone dialer (it rings automatically, you just wait for a pickup).

- Read a short, friendly script to see if the person on the phone is buying residential properties.

- If they say yes, just write down the name of the person and the time of the call on a simple list for the owner.

- That’s it! No inputting data, no system management. The owner will pull the call recordings in the morning.



Requirements:



- Flawless, articulate English communication skills with a highly professional corporate tone.

- Proven experience in US real estate lead generation, corporate outreach, or market research is highly preferred.

- Premium hardware setup: High-speed stable internet, dedicated quiet workspace, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Availability for a 1-hour onboarding and orientation session in the morning (Manila time).

- Highly resilient professional mindset with the ability to maintain consistent output.



Performance & Expectations:

Please note that while the task is simple, this is a results-driven position. We track call data, connection rates, and lead quality daily. We are looking for an action-taker who can successfully pre-qualify buyers using the script. Keeping the shift past the first 48 hours is strictly based on your daily performance and your ability to bring in verified buyer names.

title: # Social Media Manager (Part-Time, Trades / Local Service)
description:
# Social Media Manager (Part-Time, Trades / Local Service) — Strategy + Content, Long-Term



Applications that skip the steps at the bottom will be ignored.**



## About the role



We run two established Australian trade businesses: an electrical services company and a security installation company (CCTV, alarms, intercoms, access control). Both are licensed, insured, and well reviewed. We want social media that builds local trust and brings in enquiries, not vanity followers.



We are looking for a part-time Social Media Manager to work with us **long-term on an ongoing retainer**. One manager will handle both brands.



This is a **strategy and content role**. The day-to-day posting, commenting, and message replies, and local business outreach are handled in-house by our executive assistant. That means your role stays focused on planning and creating, not manual busywork. You will work directly with the business owner, who approves the monthly plan.



## What you will do



- Build a simple **monthly content plan** for both brands and get it approved by the owner

- Create the actual content: posts, graphics, and short reels

- Write captions in each brand's voice, local and human, not generic

- D
 themes, cadence, and what each platform focuses on to drive enquiries

- Report monthly on what worked and adjust the next plan accordingly



## What our EA handles (so your scope is clear)



- Scheduling and posting the content you create

- Replying to comments and direct messages

- Outreach to local builders, real estate agents, and property managers



You plan and create. The EA executes day to day off your approved plan. This keeps your hours focused and your rate fair.



## What we are looking for (must-have)



- Proven experience running social accounts for real businesses, with **live account links you can show us**

- Can **plan and create**, not just post: you can propose a monthly content plan and then produce it

- Strong short-video editing (reels, CapCut or similar)

- Graphic and post design that looks clean and professional

- Captions and copy in natural, local-sounding English, no generic filler

- Understands that the goal is **leads and enquiries**, not follower counts

- Clear written English, reliable with deadlines, comfortable working to an approved plan



## Big bonus (this moves you to the top of the pile)



- Experience with **trades or home service businesses**: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, security, builders

- Experience turning **job-site photos and clips** into content that gets engagement

- Understanding of local social: suburb reach,
 local groups, Google Business Profile posts

- Comfortable reporting on results and tying content back to enquiries



## Tools you will use



Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar video editor, and a shared content calendar we will provide. Google Business Profile experience is a plus.



## Schedule and pay



- Part-time, ongoing retainer with consistent monthly work

- Timezone overlap with Sydney, Australia (we are 2 to 3 hours ahead of Philippine time, so this is an easy overlap)

- Probationary rate for the first 30 to 60 days, then an increase based on performance

- Paid regularly via Wise or Payoneer

- No upfront or advance payments. A short **paid test** is required for final candidates.



This is a long-term role for the right person. We would rather keep one reliable manager than churn through many.



## How to apply



Start your message with the word **SPARK** so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be opened.



Then send:



1. **2 to 3 live social accounts you have run** (links, not screenshots). Trades or local service examples preferred.

2. **1 or 2 examples of reels or short videos** you edited.

3. Your **monthly rate expectation** for this part-time scope, plus your **weekly availability and timezone**.

4. Short answers to these:

   - How do you turn a social post into an actual enquiry or phone call for a local service business? Give a real example.

   - You would plan and create the content, while our EA handles posting, replies, and outreach. Are you comfortable with that split?

   - Walk us through how you would plan one month of content for a local electrician or security installer. What themes and formats would you use?

   - What do you look at to know your content is working, beyond follower count?



A 1- to 2-minute video intro is preferred but not required.



We reply to applicants who follow these steps. We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Business System and Integration Specialist
description:
Job Summary:

The Business Systems and Integrations Specialist (BSI) role sits at the intersection of AI automation, systems integration, and implementation support, helping connect tools, teams, and workflows into scalable operational processes that improve efficiency, visibility, and operational execution across the business. The BSI will work closely with internal leadership, implementation leads, and operational stakeholders to execute workflow automations, maintain integrations, support rollout initiatives, troubleshoot operational issues, and contribute to continuous process improvement efforts.

This role may enter during active systems integration, operational optimization, and platform transition initiatives involving tools such as QBO and JobTread. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working within evolving operational environments, adapting to ongoing implementation changes, and supporting execution during active rollout phases rather than only within fully established systems. This role is ideal for someone who is technically capable, operationally proactive, eager to grow within AI implementation and systems integration, and comfortable working in a collaborative and fast-moving environment. The position operates within an existing implementation and governance support structure, with guidance and escalation support already established internally for larger implementation, governance, and architectural requirements.



What You Will Do

1. AI Automations

• Own and maintain AI-powered workflows and operational automations across multiple business

functions.

• Build and optimize automation workflows using platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, Claude,

ChatGPT, and related tools.

• Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities to improve

workflow execution.

• Create and maintain prompt libraries, workflow templates, and reusable automation structures.

• Perform workflow testing, QA validation, troubleshooting, and optimization of automation

processes.

• Support AI adoption and operational enablement across teams



2. Software Implementation & Systems Integration

• Manage integrations and system connectivity across operational platforms including CRM,

project management, scheduling, accounting, and communication tools.

• Support API integrations, webhooks, workflow connections, and data synchronization between

systems.

• Troubleshoot broken automations, workflow interruptions, integration gaps, and operational

inconsistencies.

• Help maintain workflow documentation, systems organization, and operational visibility.

• Monitor automation reliability, platform performance, and workflow efficiency.

• Participate in process optimization and systems improvement initiatives.





3. Implementation Support

• Support implementation rollouts, workflow execution, onboarding, and operational adoption

initiatives.

• Coordinate implementation-related tasks, testing, follow-ups, and documentation.

• Assist with SOP creation, workflow mapping, and operational process documentation.

• Work closely with implementation leadership, project stakeholders, and operational teams

during rollout phases.

• Escalate implementation blockers, governance concerns, or technical issues when necessary.

• Help maintain organized project tracking, implementation updates, and rollout visibility.



4. Data Management, Reporting & Analytics

• Help maintain accurate and organized operational data across systems and workflows.

• Support reporting, dashboard updates, workflow monitoring, and operational visibility

initiatives.

• Assist in identifying data inconsistencies, operational gaps, and workflow improvement

opportunities.

• Support AI-assisted reporting and operational analytics initiatives.



5. Cross-Team Collaboration & Enablement

• Work closely with Operations, Finance, Sales, and HR teams to support workflow execution and

systems adoption.

• Assist users when workflows, automations, or integrations require troubleshooting or

operational support.

• Communicate implementation updates, blockers, and operational concerns clearly and

professionally.

• Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-focused, and process-driven working environment.



What We Are Looking For

Core Experience & Qualifications

• Experience in workflow automation, systems integration, operations support, or software

implementation.

• Familiarity with automation tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms.

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

• Strong organizational, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders and teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working in a remote and fast-paced environment.

• Experience supporting operational or implementation workflows is highly preferred.

AI & Automation Capabilities

What You Will Be Doing

Requirements



- Minimum 5 years of SEO experience

- Strong content writing skills — you must be able to write clear, natural English that does not sound AI-generated

- Strong understanding of on-page SEO, technical SEO and link building

- Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics and Google Business Profile

- Familiar with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush or similar

- Ability to work independently and deliver results without constant supervision

- Clear reporting and honest communication about progress

- Excellent written English



Bonus Skills

- Knowledge of WordPress SEO plugins such as Yoast or Rank Math

Pay

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Edgewood Monuments is a growing U.S. monument company with multiple locations. We design, order, produce, ship, and install custom granite headstones and memorials.



# About the Position

Our orders involve exact dimensions, granite colors, finishes, accessories, customer information, suppliers, container shipments, inventory, and multiple internal systems. Small mistakes can cause expensive remakes or months of delay.



# Mission of the Role

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for keeping purchasing, container, inventory, and project information accurate across the company. Your primary mission is to catch errors before they become expensive problems, keep orders moving, and ensure that the correct information is entered and maintained in every system. This is not a basic data-entry position. You will be expected to verify information, investigate discrepancies, follow up with others, and take ownership of tasks through completion.



# Core Competencies

### Attention to Detail

- You consistently notice small differences in dimensions, quantities, colors, project numbers, pricing, and documentation.

Ownership

- You take responsibility for getting a task fully completed, not merely passing it to someone else.

Follow-Through

- You maintain an organized follow-up system and do not allow open tasks to disappear.



### Judgment

You know when information can be verified independently and when an issue must be escalated.



### Organization

You can manage multiple open orders, shipments, deadlines, and systems without losing track of details.



### Clear Communication

You communicate discrepancies and next steps concisely and professionally.



### Process Discipline

You follow checklists and established procedures consistently, even when performing repetitive work.



### Learning Ability

You can quickly learn new terminology, software, workflows, and company procedures.



# How to Apply

Please provide:

- Your résumé.

- Your expected hourly rate.

- Your availability in Pacific Time.

- A one-to-three-minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing a meaningful error you caught before it caused a problem.

- Rate your experience from 1–10 with:

     - Google Sheets

    - Trello

    - Odoo

    - Slack

    - QuickBooks

 templates that align with our brand’s voice and aesthetic.

- Create Visual Masterpieces: Resize, cut out, and composite images to create eye-catching graphics that complement your video content.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Accountant
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Senior Accounts Payable Accountant



Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 AM EST, with a 1-hour break



Salary: $1,400 per month



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant with extensive Accounts Payable (AP) and Travel & Expense (T&E) management experience, ready to apply their knowledge and expertise in a hands-on, high-impact role and make it their own. Reporting directly to the Controller & Head of Finance, this role offers broad exposure, real ownership of the AP and expense management process, and close collaboration with Accounting, Finance, and Operations leadership.



The ideal candidate is willing to own the AP and T&E process from end to end, is comfortable partnering with non-finance teams and explaining the "why" behind processes, and is eager to take on visibility, responsibility, and the opportunity to help build scalable financial processes while supporting month-end activities, vendor payments, expense workflows, and process improvements.



This role requires someone who can independently manage high-volume AP operations, oversee the AP and T&E workflows, and require minimal day-to-day guidance while helping improve the overall AP function.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Payable & Expense Management



Own the end-to-end AP process, including vendor onboarding, invoice coding, approvals, and payment execution.

Manage corporate card and employee expense workflows using Ramp.

Manage the AP and T&E inboxes, ensuring accurate and timely processing of high-volume invoices, vendor requests, employee expenses, and payment workflows.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies while maintaining strong documentation and controls.



General Ledger & Close



Participate in closing AP at month-end.

Assist with identifying month-end accruals.

Perform balance sheet reconciliations (AP, credit cards payable, etc.).

Maintain accurate financial records in NetSuite and/or Xero.



Audit, Controls & Compliance



Support external audits, audit requests, and walkthroughs, as needed.

Partner with the Head of Fin & Acctg Mgr to strengthen internal controls as the company scales



Media & Production Cost Accounting



Collaborate with production, editorial, and operations teams to ensure accurate AP coding and vendor information gathering, cost tracking, and reconciling trackers to the general ledger.

Develop an understanding of media-specific accounting areas such as production costs, talent payments, and deal-related expenses



Process Improvement & Systems & Lead Ramp / T&E Trainings



Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency using systems, Excel, and policy documentation.

Contribute to system optimization across AP and expense management tools.

Lead onboarding and training sessions for managers and new employees related to Ramp, T&E reconciliation expectations, receipt collection requirements, and expense submission best practices.

Educate non-finance teams on expense coding structure and departmental coding expectations to improve financial reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and spend visibility.

Partner cross-functionally to reinforce timely reconciliations, proper documentation standards, and consistent coding practices across the organization.



Required Skills & Qualifications:



5+ years of progressive Accounts Payable experience, including managing high-volume AP operations.

Hands-on experience managing Travel & Expense (T&E), vendor management, and month-end close support.

Ability to independently manage AP workflows with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Experience with or exposure to accounting systems such as NetSuite, Xero, Ramp, or similar.

Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and take ownership in a lean environment.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

Experience working in media, technology, or high-growth companies.

Experience in a startup or fast-scaling organization.

Previous experience as a Senior AP Accountant, AP Lead, or AP Manager is highly preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

/flow) and propose changes based on what the data shows

Requirements

• Demonstrated hands-on Klaviyo experience, not just “familiar with,” able to show flows or campaigns you've built

• Able to design the
s themselves in Figma, Canva, or a similar tool with clean, on-brand layouts, not just copy dropped into a default template

• Comfortable owning a channel with minimal day-to-day direction (this is not a “tell me exactly what to send” role)

• Strong written English and a good ear for tone as you'll be writing to real customers

• E-commerce/Shopify experience preferred

• Bonus: experience with an older or lifestyle/hobbyist customer base, or apparel/DTC brands specifically

Hours 

~20 hours/week, part-time. Starts with a paid 2–4 week paid trial.

How to Apply

Reply with: (1) 2–3 examples of Klaviyo flows or campaigns you've designed and built yourself - include the actual
 design, not just copy (Figma/Canva files, screenshots, or a portfolio link, with metrics if you have them), (2) your available hours with time zone, and (3) a one-paragraph answer to: “If you had a Shopify store with a 30-day abandoned cart problem and no flows set up yet, what would you build first, and why?” Applications without #1 and #3 won't be considered.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator & Offer Writer | Washington State | Remote Full-Time
description:
We are a large real estate team based in Washington State looking for an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator & Offer Writer to support our agents, clients, and transaction process.



This role is focused on preparing offers and contracts, managing transactions from mutual acceptance to closing, tracking deadlines, supporting listing paperwork, and keeping records organized across our systems.



We need someone who understands Washington State real estate, NWMLS forms, contract timelines, and the importance of speed and accuracy. This is a fast-paced role where agents may need offers prepared quickly, so responsiveness and attention to detail are critical.



You’ll be helping with:



• Preparing buyer contracts, listing contracts, addenda, and related paperwork

• Writing offers quickly and accurately based on agent instructions

• Managing transactions from mutual acceptance through closing

• Tracking timelines, contingency deadlines, and important transaction milestones

• Coordinating with escrow, title, lenders, inspectors, photographers, vendors, agents, and clients

• Ensuring NWMLS contract compliance and complete document management

• Supporting agents with paperwork, contract questions, and transaction logistics

• Serving as an administrative point of contact for clients during escrow

• Maintaining accurate records in Compass, Google Drive, CRM systems, and transaction platforms

• Supporting listing coordination, MLS input, and listing-related documentation

• Managing updates inside tools such as Compass CRM, Follow Up Boss, Redfin Partner Portal, Zillow-related CRM systems, Transaction Desk, Slack, and Google Workspace



We are looking for someone who has:



• 3+ years of real estate transaction coordination, contract management, or offer writing experience

• Strong Washington State real estate experience preferred

• Experience with NWMLS forms and Transaction Desk preferred

• Strong understanding of real estate deadlines, contingencies, and contract-to-close workflows

• Excellent written English, grammar, and professional communication skills

• A friendly, polished, and professional communication style

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy with contracts and documents

• Ability to work quickly under deadlines without sacrificing quality

• Experience supporting a large real estate team with multiple agents is a plus

• Familiarity with Compass, Follow Up Boss, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Slack, Redfin Partner Portal, and CRM systems is helpful



This is a full-time remote role. We are only considering candidates who do not have any other active jobs, freelance clients, or agency commitments. All assigned work must be completed by you directly and cannot be outsourced, delegated, or shared with another person.



Pay: $9 to $11/hour depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time

Location: Remote, supporting a Washington State real estate team

Industry: Residential real estate

title: Accounting Operations Specialist – U.S. Accounting Firm
description:
Remote | U.S.-Based Accounting & Business Advisory Firm



About Atlanta Business Services



Atlanta Business Services is a growing U.S.-based accounting and business advisory firm that provides accounting, bookkeeping, financial insights, and business support services to growing companies.



We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Operations Specialist to support our accounting team.



This is a hands-on accounting and operations role for someone who enjoys bookkeeping, working with structured processes, documenting information, and helping a team stay organized.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working behind the scenes while also attending designated client meetings to document important information, decisions, and follow-up items.



This is not a sales position or financial advisory position.



Position Purpose



The Accounting Operations Specialist supports our Client Account Specialists by completing recurring bookkeeping and accounting production tasks, maintaining accurate client documentation, assisting with client spreadsheets, and helping ensure Atlanta Business Services' Standard Operating Procedures are properly documented and maintained.



A major responsibility of this role is helping information move efficiently from:



Client Conversation ? Documentation ? Task Assignment ? Follow-Up ? Completion



The Accounting Operations Specialist helps ensure important client information, accounting questions, and follow-up items do not get lost.



Primary Responsibilities

Accounting & Bookkeeping Production

Categorize and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts.

Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable bookkeeping.

Record payroll journal entries using established procedures.

Review uncategorized transactions and identify items requiring clarification.

Complete assigned month-end close checklist tasks.

Maintain supporting accounting documentation.

Identify bookkeeping discrepancies and escalate questions to the assigned Client Account Specialist.

Assist with recurring accounting schedules and client reporting support.

Follow written SOPs, checklists, and video instructions.

Complete assigned tasks by established deadlines.

Document work completed and communicate unresolved accounting items.

Client Meeting Documentation & Follow-Up

Attend designated client meetings with Client Account Specialists and other Atlanta Business Services tea
mbers.

Listen carefully and document important client discussions.

Prepare clear and organized meeting notes.

Enter meeting notes into the firm's practice management software.

Document client decisions, requests, and accounting information discussed during meetings.

Identify action items and follow-up responsibilities.

Create or update tasks in the practice management software based on meeting discussions.

Assign or route follow-up items to the appropriate tea
mber according to established procedures.

Document due dates and follow-up deadlines.

Maintain an accurate record of unresolved client questions.

Flag accounting or client issues requiring Client Account Specialist review.

Assist the team with tracking outstanding client documents and information.



The Accounting Operations Specialist is not responsible for independently providing accounting advice or financial recommendations during client meetings.



Technical accounting questions should be documented and escalated to the appropriate Client Account Specialist.



Standard Operating Procedure Documentation & Maintenance

Assist with creating written Standard Operating Procedures from team instructions and training videos.

Review Loom videos and convert processes into organized written SOPs.

Format SOPs using Atlanta Business Services' approved SOP template.

Document the purpose, frequency, responsible role, required systems, and steps for each process.

Include appropriate escalation procedures within SOPs.

Maintain the firm's SOP library.

Review SOPs for outdated information.

Update SOPs when approved processes change.

Maintain SOP creation and revision dates.

Identify recurring processes that do not have documented SOPs.

Notify the appropriate process owner when an SOP may need to be created or updated.

Ensure SOP documents are properly named, organized, and stored.



The Accounting Operations Specialist does not independently change Atlanta Business Services' accounting or operational procedures.



Process changes must be approved by the appropriate process owner or management tea
mber before the SOP is updated.



Excel & Client Spreadsheet Support

Perform accurate data entry into client Excel spreadsheets.

Maintain recurring client spreadsheets and accounting schedules.

Transfer financial and operational data between approved systems and spreadsheets.

Review spreadsheets for missing or duplicate information.

Sort and filter data.

Perform basic spreadsheet reconciliations.

Use basic and intermediate Excel formulas as needed.

Assist with maintaining client tracking spreadsheets.

Compare spreadsheet totals to accounting system reports when required.

Identify differences and escalate discrepancies to the Client Account Specialist.

Maintain accuracy and consistency when entering high volumes of financial data.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of bookkeeping or accounting support experience.

Strong QuickBooks Online experience.

Experience completing bank and credit card reconciliations.

Strong understanding of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles.

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms strongly preferred.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong English listening comprehension.

Ability to understand accounting terminology used during client conversations.

Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience working with spreadsheets and performing detailed data entry.

Strong attention to detail.

Experience following written SOPs, checklists, and video instructions.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Ability to manage multiple client assignments and deadlines.

Comfortable attending virtual client meetings.

Comfortable taking detailed meeting notes.

Ability to work independently and communicate when clarification is needed.

Reliable internet connection and professional remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working for a U.S. accounting or bookkeeping firm.

Experience supporting multiple accounting clients simultaneously.

Experience using accounting practice management software.

Experience creating or maintaining Standard Operating Procedures.

Experience converting training videos or Loom recordings into written SOPs.

Experience using task or project management software.

Experience maintaining client accounting schedules.

Experience with payroll journal entries.

Experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

The Ideal Candidate



You are organized, dependable, and comfortable working within structured processes.



You enjoy accounting and bookkeeping work but also understand the importance of strong documentation and follow-up.



You listen carefully.



You take detailed notes.



You notice when information is missing.



You do not guess when you are unsure.



You ask clear and organized questions.



You understand the difference between completing a task and independently changing a process.



You are comfortable receiving instructions through written SOPs, checklists, and training videos.



You understand that completing accounting work accurately is more important than simply completing tasks quickly.



You enjoy helping a team stay organized and making sure important information does not get lost.



This Position Does Not Require

Sales.

Business development.

Financial advisory services.

Fractional CFO analysis.

Independent client financial recommendations.

Leading client relationship management.

Final financial statement review.

Independently changing accounting policies or firm procedures.

Schedule



This is a remote position.



Full-time or part-time opportunities may be considered based on experience and availability.



Regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required to attend designated client meetings and communicate with the Atlanta Business Services team.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



A brief description of your bookkeeping and accounting experience.

The number of years you have used QuickBooks Online.

A description of your experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms.

A description of your Excel experience.

A description of any experience creating or maintaining SOPs.

A description of your experience attending virtual client meetings or documenting meeting notes.

Your current work availability.

The U.S. Eastern Time hours you are available to work.

Your desired hourly or monthly compensation.

A link to a video answering the screening questions below.



Applications that do not follow all instructions may not be considered.



Video Screening Questions



Please record a video of no more than 5 minutes answering the following questions:



Question 1



A bank reconciliation does not balance. Explain how you would investigate the difference before asking your supervisor for help.



Question 2



You attend a client meeting and the client mentions five different accounting issues, agrees to send two documents, and asks for a report by Friday.



Explain what you would do immediately after the meeting to ensure nothing is missed.



Question 3



You are following a written SOP, but the QuickBooks file does not match the process shown in the SOP.



Explain how you would handle the situation.



We are evaluating your accounting knowledge, English communication, organization, judgment, and ability to follow established processes.

description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a data-driven Marketing Strategist (Digital Experience) to lead the optimization of our online customer touchpoints. You will be responsible for crafting strategies that elevate the brand, increase organic traffic, and optimize digital experiences to drive lead generation and sales. By combining customer behavior insights with digital marketing best practices, you will ensure a seamless and personalized journey across all digital channels. 



Key Responsibilities

- Digital Experience & UX Strategy: Map and optimize the digital customer journey, ensuring a seamless, user-friendly experience across our website, landing pages, and mobile apps.

- Campaign Development: Design and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies across SEO/SEM, paid media (PPC),
, and social media. 

- Analytics & Optimization: Utilize web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics 4, Hotjar) to monitor site traffic, track conversion rates, and conduct A/B testing on digital assets to improve user flow and ROI.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Product, Web Development, Design, and Content teams to implement UX improvements and maintain brand consistency across all digital platforms. 

- Content & Personalization Strategy: Develop a robust content calendar and personalization strategy to ensure the right messaging reaches target audience segments at the right time.

- Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of the curve regarding digital marketing trends, UX/UI best practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI in marketing, algorithm updates).



Qualifications & Requirements 

- Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital strategy, or UX marketing, preferably in an agency or fast-paced in-house environment.

- Technical Skills:

Proficiency with digital marketing and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, SEO tools like SEMrush or Ahrefs).

Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and marketing automation (e.g., Marketo, Mailchimp).

Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Contentful) is a plus.

- Soft Skills: Excellent project management abilities, strong analytical thinking, and effective communication skills to present strategies to stakeholders.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) improvements

- Website bounce rates and average session duration

- Organic traffic growth and Search Engine Ranking

- Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

- Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and retention rates

title: Real Estate Cold Caller & Appointment Setter (Pre foreclosure/Probate)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:



We're a US-based real estate investment business specializing in pre foreclosure and probate properties, looking for a reliable, empathetic virtual assistant to handle outbound calling and appointment setting. You'll be our first point of contact with property owners, so a warm phone presence, professionalism, and consistency are essential. This is a long-term role with room to grow as we scale.



Responsibilities:



Make outbound calls to pre foreclosure and probate leads from provided lists

Follow our scripts while adapting naturally to each conversation Qualify leads based on their situation, timeline, and motivation Set appointments and hand off qualified leads with complete, accurate notes Log all call outcomes and dispositions in our CRM Hit daily call volume and contact targets Send a brief end-of-day summary of activity and results



Requirements:



Fluent, clear English with a neutral, friendly phone voice

Comfortable with high call volume and handling rejection calmly Empathetic and tactful many contacts are facing foreclosure or a death in the family and must always be treated with respect Organized and accurate with CRM data entry Self-directed and dependable in a remote role reliable computer, noise-cancelling headset, and stable high-speed internet (please state your speed)



Preferred (not required):



Prior real estate cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

Familiarity with pre foreclosure or probate leads Experience with dialers and REI CRMs Understanding of TCPA/DNC calling compliance



TO APPLY:



Reply with your resume attached.

Record a 1–2 minute voice sample answering the three questions below. Use your phone's voice recorder or computer, upload the file to Google Drive, and paste the shareable link in your application. Important: set the link sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" so I can actually open it.

In your voice recording, answer:



Why would you be a good fit for a cold-calling role?

Tell me about a time you had to stay calm with a difficult or upset person.

What are your available hours in US [Eastern/Pacific] time?





Put the word "HOMESTEAD" at the top of your written application so I know you read the full post.

Tell me your internet speed (run a quick test at speedtest.net).



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Remote Creative Strategist
description:
Fixed Base Salary + Aggressive performance bonuses 



We're a fast-growing DTC company building products people genuinely love and trust — and we're looking for Creative Strategists who live and breathe avatars, angles, and hooks. The difference here: when your creative wins, you win. Hit your targets and you earn a percentage of the ad spend your winning ads unlock. If you back your ideas, this is where you bet on yourself — and build real financial freedom doing it. 



Why this role is different 

Uncapped upside. Winning ads earn you a share of the spend they drive. Your ceiling is set by your results, not a fixed salary band. 

We invest in you. Courses, mentorship, and hands-on training from top creative and marketing talent. You'll leave every quarter sharper than you started. 

Products you'll actually care about. A wide and growing portfolio means you get to work on brands and products you're excited about — with new launches landing regularly. 

You're building the foundation. Our mission is to build iconic brands consumers love and trust. Great creative is how those products reach the world. This role sits at the heart of that. 



What you'll do 

Research relentlessly — deep-dive into our avatars (who we target), angles (what we say), and ad types (how we say it). 

Develop winning ad concepts and briefs that guide our designers and video editors to produce scroll-stopping creative for Meta and YouTube. 

Partner with the creative team to bring ideas to life with clarity, emotion, and precision. 

Work with our CRO team to keep messaging congruent across ads, landing pages, and funnels. 

Analyze performance data to learn which angles, hooks, and visuals drive results — then double down on what works. 



What success looks like 

A consistent stream of winning ad concepts that scale on Meta and YouTube 

Landing pages that measurably lift conversion 

Tight collaboration and clear communication across teams 

Fast, data-driven iteration — testing and learning as a default 



Who you are 

Proven experience as a Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Graphic Designer, or Video Editor 

Strong grasp of ad psychology, storytelling, and creative direction 

Obsessed with research, trends, and what makes people click 

Sharp prioritization — you know what matters and what doesn't 

A tester at heart — you love learning from data 

Excellent English communication 



How we work 

Team Player — we win together 

Hungry & growth-oriented — always leveling up 

Speed — move fast, learn fast 

Innovation — challenge the norm 

Effort & attitude — bring your best every day 



The details 

Full-time, fully remote (Philippines-based) 

Base pay plus performance incentive tied to winning ads 

A growth-focused culture surrounded by top creative and marketing talent 



Ready to build what's next? 



If you're obsessed with turning ideas into high-performing ads — and you want your pay to reflect the wins you create — we want to hear from you. 



Explore Our Brands
