title: Remote Video Editor
description:
Do you know how to hook someone? Do you know how to tell a story? Can you make someone stop scrolling and watch?



If yes — we want to talk to you.



We're looking for a superstar video editor who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prove it. In return, we're offering a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus when your videos deliver results.



Ready to join Orca Brands? We're on a mission to be the best employer in the Philippines — offering real growth opportunities, hands-on training, a tight-knit culture, and a thriving e-commerce community. We run quarterly employee awards and offer top performers the chance to visit us in the USA.



If you are AVERAGE. DO NOT APPLY. THERE will be 2 - 3 tests you will need to pass and we only have 2 spots open.



About the Role



As Mr. Beast says, "the magic happens in the editing room." This role demands strong storytelling instincts, a deep understanding of e-commerce video trends, and the ability to craft videos that hook and hold attention — with minimal hand-holding.



You'll collaborate closely with our marketing and creative teams to bring products to life through visual storytelling that drives conversions and builds brand visibility.



Primary Responsibilities



Edit and produce high-converting video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

Transform raw footage and creative briefs into videos that capture and hold attention from first frame to last

Craft compelling narratives using motion graphics, text overlays, sound design, and effects

Optimize videos for platform-specific formats across mobile and desktop

Work autonomously — take scripts, clips, and hooks and turn them into polished, attention-grabbing content

Highlight key selling points, user testimonials, and product demonstrations through smart editing

Stay ahead of trends in video marketing, storytelling, and social media best practices

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and hitting deadlines



Qualifications



Proven experience as a video editor — ideally in e-commerce, social media marketing, DTC brands, or film

Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or comparable software

Strong understanding of social media ad formats, aspect ratios, and platform-specific requirements

Experience with motion graphics, text animation, and sound design

Collaborative mindset — excited to work cross-functionally toward shared business goals

About Orca Brands



Orca Brands is a fast-growing e-commerce company dedicated to building high-quality beauty and wellness products. Our marketing team thrives on delivering compelling, high-performing video content that resonates with real audiences and drives real sales.



Learn more: 
 |

Submit your portfolio — especially videos that grab and hold attention. Show us you can bring a creative concept to life and make viewers stop, watch, and buy.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper & Reporting Analyst (QuickBooks + Jobber) – US Junk Removal Company
description:
About Us

We’re a fast-growing junk removal & light demolition company in Tampa Bay, Florida. We run a tight ship and care a lot about our numbers. We already have solid systems (Jobber, QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets, AI exports). We now need a pro to own bookkeeping, reconciliations, and reporting QA.



This is not a basic VA role. This is for an experienced bookkeeper / accountant who has managed books for US service businesses before.



Role Overview

You will be responsible for:



Keeping QuickBooks Online clean and accurate (you'll work with out bookkeeper and mostly work through spreadsheets)

Reconciling our Jobber ? QBO data and AI exports

Preparing simple, reliable weekly and monthly reports so the owner can make decisions fast

Rough time expectation: 10–15 hours/week, with room to grow as we grow.



Responsibilities

Weekly



Review AI / Jobber exports (jobs, revenue, services) into Google Sheets

Check for errors, missing data, or obvious anomalies and correct them

Update a simple Weekly Performance Sheet:

Jobs completed

Revenue by product line

COGS (from QBO)

Ad spend by channel (Google Ads, LSA, Meta – we will provide numbers)

Net after ads

Flag anything that looks off (sudden margin drops, weird spikes, negative items, etc.) and send a short summary.



Monthly



Ensure Jobber invoices / payments are correctly mapped for our bookkeeper to QBO products & income accounts

Prepare the payroll summary (hours, OT, tips, commissions) in our template for our payroll provider weekly

Provide a short loom or bullet summary of what changed vs last month (good/bad/ugly).



Requirements

3+ years bookkeeping experience for US-based businesses

Strong QuickBooks Online skills (certification preferred)

Experience with at least one field-service or job management tool (Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, etc. – Jobber is a big plus)

Comfortable reading and cleaning exports in Google Sheets

Able to spot inconsistencies and explain them clearly in English

Stable internet and availability for a recurring weekly and monthly cadence

Detail-obsessed and comfortable saying “this doesn’t reconcile, here’s why.”

How to Apply (Read Carefully)

 / message with subject line:

BOOKKEEPER – [Your Name] – [Years with US clients]



Include ALL of the following:



Link to your Onlinejobs.ph profile



Your CV / resume (PDF or link)



A short Loom video (2–4 minutes) walking through:



One P&L you prepared (blur sensitive data)

How you use QBO to reconcile a bank account

Screenshots or examples of any reports you’ve built for owners (weekly, monthly, dashboards – blur names).

Experience with jobber or similar software



A short written answer to:



a) Describe your experience with QuickBooks Online and any certifications.

b) Have you worked with Jobber or similar tools? Explain.

c) Explain, I can't provide cloning or replication instructions. Jobber ? QBO ? bank for one month.

d) What monthly fee would you charge to handle the responsibilities above, and why?

Break down your estimate: hours, your hourly rate, and how your experience justifies this price.

e) On a scale of 1–10, how confident are you in spotting mistakes in someone else’s report, and why?



There is room after onboarding to take over bookkeeping entirely, which would be an expanded role.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

Innovation and results are at the heart of everything we do. We're seeking a Marketing Manager who thrives at the intersection of strategy, technology, and performance — someone who can harness the power of AI to scale marketing campaigns, personalize customer journeys, and deliver measurable ROI.



Position Summary

The Marketing Manager will lead the development and execution of AI-enhanced, multi-channel marketing strategies. This role demands a strong understanding of data-driven marketing and automation tools. You'll collaborate across departments, manage a high-output team, and be directly responsible for hitting KPIs related to brand reach, lead generation, and campaign performance — all while utilizing cutting-edge AI tools to stay ahead of the curve.

Collaborate with Sales and Product teams to align messaging and drive pipeline growth



Analyze data from AI-powered dashboards and adjust strategies in real time

Brand Lift: Track and improve brand sentiment and recognition through AI-powered social listening



Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Science, or a related field



5+ years of experience in marketing, with at least 2 years managing or leading AI-enhanced campaigns



Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms and AI tools (e.g., HubSpot, Jasper, Salesforce Einstein, ChatGPT, Mutiny, etc.)



Proficient in analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau) and A/B testing frameworks



Strong grasp of marketing performance metrics, growth loops, and funnel optimization



Demonstrated leadership, strategic thinking, and an innovation mindset

Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and two examples of marketing campaigns where you've used AI tools or automation to drive success.

title: PAID MEDIA MANAGER
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



Department: Marketing

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM MST

Compensation: $8–10/hour, DOE



ROLE OVERVIEW

Responsible for driving leads to clients through planning, executing, optimizing, and analyzing Google Ads paid search campaigns, while owning local SEO, conversion tracking, and attribution accuracy across multiple client accounts — working closely with the project manager and web development team to keep everything connected.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

Ensure access to all required advertising and analytics accounts (Google Ads, Analytics, Tag Manager, Website backend).

Audit client's existing Google Ads campaigns and overall paid search efforts.

Audit client websites to identify keyword opportunities.

Develop keyword strategies around brand, services, locations, and competitor analysis.

Plan and build campaigns across Search and Performance Max — including broad, phrase, and exact match targeting, retargeting, seasonal, and testing campaigns.

Continuously optimize keywords, add negatives, refine bids, adjust budgets, and test ads.

Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns when required.



Attribution, Conversion Tracking & Lead Quality

Ensure access to the attribution/call tracking system and confirm it's properly connected to Google Ads.

Set up and maintain conversion and goal tracking between Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, and the client website — working with the web development team (or independently, with working knowledge of the backend and GTM) to make sure tracking code is implemented correctly for retargeting and conversions.

Review daily lead quality and performance through the attribution system.

Flag conversion or tracking issues early, before they affect reporting accuracy or client results.



Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Collaboration

Not responsible for web development — but works directly with the web development team and partners to identify and implement CRO opportunities on landing pages and lead forms.

Ensures keyword messaging stays consistent between ad campaigns and landing page content.



Performance Cadence & PM Collaboration

This role does not send client reports directly — the project manager owns report delivery. Maintain constant, proactive communication with the project manager to keep them informed and confirm accuracy before anything goes to a client.

Prepare PPC, SEO/GBP, and attribution performance data on a consistent cadence (bi-weekly check-ins, monthly reporting cycle) for the project manager to compile and send.

Write clear, outcome-driven performance summaries and next-step recommendations for each account — not just raw data.

Log all account activity and PM communication in ClickUp.



Local SEO, GBP & Organic Search

Conduct organic keyword research and on-page SEO recommendations to support local search visibility.

Ensure access to GBP and manage verification steps, including 72-hour approval requests.

Manage client Google Business Profiles through our preferred SEO tracking software (setup, integrations, updates, posts, services, weekly photo uploads).

Local directory listing and citation management — currently owned by the SEO team, with room to grow into this over time.

Collaborate with the content/SEO team on keyword intent, copy, and on-page strategy.



Quality Assurance

Review all data and insights for accuracy before handing off to the project manager.

Identify red flags (low conversions, poor lead quality, tracking issues) early and raise them proactively — before they become client-facing problems.



REQUIREMENTS

Required:

Google Ads experience with local service-based businesses — not ecommerce.

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

Experience managing an attribution/call tracking system and setting up conversion/goal tracking through Google Tag Manager.

Comfortable navigating a website backend and Google Tag Manager — not web development, but enough technical fluency to implement and troubleshoot tracking code alongside a developer.

Strong keyword research and SEO experience, ideally with a local/brick-and-mortar focus.

Demonstrated conversion rate optimization (CRO) experience — able to spot opportunities and collaborate with a developer to implement them.

Strong writing skills — able to turn data into clear, outcome-driven performance summaries, not just numbers.

Strong written and verbal English communication.

Proactive communicator — comfortable working directly with the project manager, team, and leadership without heavy oversight.

Comfortable in a small, fast-moving agency that's actively building out its systems and SOPs — willing to help spot gaps and improve processes rather than wait to be told.



Preferred (Not Required):

Meta Ads or other paid advertising platform experience — room to grow into broader agency-level ad work.

Fitness studio or gym industry experience.

Personal interest in health and fitness — helps build understanding of our clients and the mission behind the work.



TOOLS USED

Google Ads · Google Analytics · Google Tag Manager · CallRail · Google Workspace · ClickUp · SEO tracking software · Meta Ads (a plus)

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Who we are:

ColdBru is a next-gen DTC growth team that partners with DTC brands to drastically improve their growth trajectory when other options don't move the bottom line. Our purpose is to help people learn, grow and be the best versions of themselves through the journey of entrepreneurship. We are committed to being the unfair advantage behind our partner brands, and launching a group of our own brands to operate.



We value being fast, data-driven, customer-centric, and adaptable in our approach.

Simply put, ColdBru is the unfair advantage behind its partners' bottom-line growth.



What you'll do (EST time zone overlap required):

Support our growth team in the trenches of performance marketing and AI-powered customer experience optimization.



Execute day-to-day performance tracking and reposting across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok campaigns - you'll be the one catching data discrepancies before they become problems and keeping our reporting bulletproof.



Assist with campaign setup and launches across multiple advertising channels, helping our media buyers move fast without breaking things.



Manage AI customer service tools across multiple client accounts - you'll be optimizing AI systems, reviewing AI responses for brand consistency, and escalating the complex stuff that needs human touch.



Generate performance summaries and insights that actually matter, not just vanity metrics (we're all about that bottom-line impact).



Help maintain marketing calendars, campaign schedules, and project timelines so nothing falls through the cracks.



Support various growth experiments and initiatives - when we need to test something new, you'll be right there helping make it happen.



The Growth Marketing Assistant will work closely with our media buying and growth teams.



We move fast and details matter - if a campaign is off by even 1% in tracking, you catch it. If an AI response doesn't sound like our client's brand, you fix it. You're the safety net that lets our team swing for the fences without worrying about the fundamentals. If you get this, put your go-to productivity hack in ALL CAPS in the first line of your application.



Who you are:

You have some experience in digital marketing, social media, or performance marketing and you're hungry to level up fast.



You're obsessed with getting things right the first time and have an eye for details that others miss. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball and actually enjoy the puzzle of troubleshooting data discrepancies.



You're looking to learn from a world-class team and want hands-on experience with the tools and strategies that drive real growth at scale.



Nice To Have/Bonus Skills:

- Experience with Google Analytics,
 
, or other marketing analytics tools

- Familiarity with AI customer service platforms or chatbot management

- Knowledge of Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or other advertising platforms beyond Meta

- Experience with project management tools (Asana, 
, Notion)

- Basic understanding of marketing automation



Where we're going:

We're a team of handpicked individuals hell-bent on profitable growth for the sake of it, we get up in the morning energized to crack the latest growth problems wide open just cause it sounds fun. We wouldn't settle for anything less and don't take 'No' for an answer. No task is too big or too small, if it's needed to achieve profitable growth we find a way to do it or get it done. We aren't on a hiring spree and will only onboard someone on the same wavelength. That being said, if you think you can outperform and don't have all the experience above, we're open to chatting - ownership and follow-through are what we really care about.



Benefits:

Learn from a world-class team leading the space

In 6 months you'll learn more than other people learn in 3 years

Essentially unlimited self-improvement budget (online courses, and other educational experiences)

Retreats

Flexible working hours

Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world (need to overlap with PST work hours)

Performance incentives

A coffee stipend, if you work at ColdBru you don't pay for coffee. Period.

A wellness budget, we care about your physical and mental well-being, this stipend is there to help you with it, however you see fit.

No meetings Friday, and if you get all your work done by Thursday, take Friday afternoon off!



To apply
 
 & put coffee as your word to be considered

title: Brand Copywriter — House of Indigo™
description:
House of Indigo™ is a boutique hybrid publishing company in personal development, spirituality, and wellness. We publish curated anthologies, run group programs, and build community around healing and transformation. Our audience is wellness-aware, spiritually curious, and values depth over hype.

We're looking for a skilled copywriter who can write in an established brand voice — warm, professional, with a touch of sass, story-led, never salesy or broadcast-y. This is not a role where you bring your own voice. You'll learn ours and write from inside it.



What You'll Be Writing



One long-form monthly piece for our Substack (800 to 1,200 words), themed around publishing, healing, or community

A newsletter excerpt that drives readers to the full Substack post

2 to 3 social media captions or post hooks per week for Instagram and LinkedIn

Occasional sales page copy,
 sequences, or launch copy as needed



Hours and Pay

Roughly 6 to 8 hours a month to start, with room to grow as we launch new offers and programs. Rate negotiable based on experience and portfolio.



What We're Looking For



Strong writing portfolio, ideally with samples across long-form and short-form

Experience writing for or to wellness, spirituality, coaching, or publishing audiences — you don't need to be an expert in wellness, but you need to understand how to speak to people who are

Ability to match and maintain an established brand voice, not just write well generally

Reliable, responsive communication

Comfortable using AI tools like Claude on occasion for research and first drafts while maintaining quality and voice integrity



To Apply

Share 2 to 3 writing samples that best represent your range. At least one should be long-form and one short-form. Tell us briefly why you think you're a good fit for a brand in the wellness and publishing space.

title: Video Editor Wanted — Fully AI-Generated YouTube Channel
description:

Documentary-style, storytelling-focused content — think Crumb Lore and WeirdwardBound.


 


 


 



About this channel

This is a 100% AI YouTube channel: scripts are written by me, voice-over is AI-generated (not a human narrator), and all visuals are AI-generated (via Midjourney, DALL-E, Runway, Kling, Pika, or similar) — no real photos, archive footage, or stock clips

Please only apply if you're comfortable working entirely with AI-generated visuals and AI-narrated content — if that's not for you, no hard feelings, just let us know upfront



The job

You provide: AI-generated visuals for every scene (images, video clips, historical recreations, dramatized 
nts), animations, transitions, subtitles, background music, sound effects, and final export

title: Office Administrator / Receptionist — Small Business Support
description:
We support a Nashville window cleaning company (~20 employees, in business since 2013) that needs a reliable, full-time Office Administrator to keep daily operations running. You'd work directly with the business's team and customers — alongside another Filipino professional we placed with this company, who has become central to their operations and will help you get up to speed. You won't be figuring things out alone.



**What you'll do:**

- Answer the company's incoming calls — customers scheduling service, asking questions, checking on jobs (we train you on the details)

- Make outbound customer calls — confirmations, follow-ups

- Build and adjust crew schedules; dispatch/routing support

- Send invoices and track payments

- Track attendance and daily check-ins

- Keep records and files organized

- Other admin tasks as the business needs — small company, everyone pitches in



This is a small business, not a call center — you won't be taking 80 calls a day. Between calls, the admin work above fills the day; what matters is answering when the phone rings.



Most of this is trained. What we can't train: reliability, organization, and excellent spoken English.



**Requirements:**

- Excellent SPOKEN English (C2 level, OnlineJobs.ph English test taken before applying) — you'll be on the phone with American customers daily; the interview is conducted entirely in English by phone

- College degree (verified during the background check)

- **Full-time US Central Time DAY shift: 9 AM–5 PM CT** (= 10 PM–6 AM Philippine time) — confirm you can sustain a night schedule

- Own laptop + stable internet + quiet workspace (phone work)

- Background check required

- Highly organized

- **Reliable attendance:** you're the company's phone line during business hours — at your desk and reachable through the shift



**Strongly preferred:**

- Phone customer-service experience (receptionist, CSR, or voice BPO)

- Office administration or scheduling experience



**Preferred:**

- Small-business experience

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and learning new software



**What we offer:**

- **$6.00/hr (~$1,040/month)**, full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Central

- Paid holidays on the US schedule (the business closes)

- 5 paid sick days + 1 personal day per year (after 60 days)

- Stable long-term role with an established business (in business since 2013)



**To apply:** apply through OnlineJobs.ph starting with the word LANTERN, and include a link to a 30–60 second voice recording (
 is fine) — introduce yourself and tell us about your last job. Speak naturally; don't read a script.

title: Opportunity for a Video Editor & Reels Specialist
description:
We're a growing parent-education brand (Early Smile Guidance) teaching parents how to support their children's jaw and facial development for lifelong health. 

We need a skilled video editor for a part-time, ~15 hours/week role to turn our raw footage into polished long-form YouTube videos and punchy, scroll-stopping Reels/Shorts.



Detailed Responsibilities:

Your daily/weekly responsibilities would include:

- Edit long-form YouTube videos (10–20 min) from raw footage — cuts, pacing, captions/subtitles, simple graphics, intro/outro, color correction. Keep in mind that we contribute health-related material, for parents age 20 to 35.

- Cut long-form videos into 3–5 short-form Reels/Shorts per video — vertical format, captions, hooks in the first 3 seconds, trending audio when relevant

- Maintain an organized project/file naming system in Google Drive so past footage can be reused

- Send a daily report detailing completed and ongoing tasks



Required Technical Skills and Experience:

To qualify for the position, you will need at least 1–2 years of experience in:

Video editing (please specify which software you use)

Short-form vertical editing for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok — pacing, captions, hook-driven cuts

Basic motion graphics or text overlay work (captions, lower thirds, simple animations)



It's really important that you are:

A fast learner who can absorb brand voice and style quickly

Detail-oriented — accuracy matters, especially with health/parenting content

A self-starter who can work with minimal daily supervision

Flexible enough to occasionally add up to 5 extra hours in a given week when needed



Basic Skills:

In addition to EXCELLENT ENGLISH SKILLS, you'll need to use:

Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets

Communication apps: WhatsApp and Zoom

Project management tools: Monday

Time tracking software (Toggl Track or similar)



Desired Technical Skills (optional, nice to have) - If you have these, it's a plus:

Familiarity with Kajabi or YouTube channel management

Experience with tools like VidIQ or TubeBuddy for optimization

Basic thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)



Samples of the Type of Work we Expect:





Work Schedule:

This is a part-time position, ~15 hours/week, Monday to Friday (roughly 4 hours/day). Hours can be flexible as long as there's at least 2–3 hours of daily overlap with the Mexico City time zone and daily deliverables (edited content) are submitted on schedule.

Some weeks may require up to 5 extra hours (e.g., launch weeks, higher content volume, or urgent turnarounds) — please only apply if you have the bandwidth to flex up occasionally. This isn't a weekly guarantee, just a capacity we need you to have available when asked, with reasonable notice.

Once you complete a successful 3-month trial period, you'll receive a rate increase based on performance and reliability. After 6+ months, you'll also be eligible for a holiday bonus at our discretion.



Salary:

$5–$7 per hour, for ~15 hours/week, depending on experience. Extra hours in weeks that require it are paid at the same hourly rate.



Career Potential:

As our content output grows, there's potential to take on more creative ownership — helping shape thumbnail strategy, content calendar planning, and eventually managing a small content team.



Details on How to Apply:

When applying, put "Tiny Teeth" in the subject heading AND last sentence. 

Please include:

- A link to your portfolio or 2–3 sample edits (ideally one long-form, one short-form)

- Which editing software you use

- A one-paragraph example: pick any short video and tell us how you'd cut it into 3 Reels.

- Highlight any other skills that you have that may benefit our digital product.

title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring Media Buyers Who Can Think Strategically, Learn Fast, and Execute Cleanly



We’re looking for 1 full-time Media Buyer to join our remote team directly.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands — but we are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks blindly.



We’re looking for people who understand media buying at a strategic level, can think through campaign decisions, recognize patterns in performance, and know when to take action, when to hold, and when to escalate.



You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 1

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

Workload: 80 hours per 2-week period, agreed upon at hire



Team Structure:

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Be open to feedback and treat it as an opportunity to improve

Be responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Be able to document your work clearly and consistently

Know when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Be willing to learn our internal systems while also bringing your own media buying judgment to the role



As a Media Buyer, You Will Be Responsible For:

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

Launching and maintaining campaigns using predefined structures

Monitoring performance signals and campaign pacing daily

Making thoughtful changes only when the data and signals justify it

Understanding the reason behind campaign actions, not just completing tasks mechanically

Documenting actions, updates, and observations inside ClickUp

Making FTW the second word in your application headline, followed by your first name

Flagging account, campaign, or performance issues early

Escalating when something truly feels off, without overreacting to every small dip

Joining structured check-ins with the Lead Media Buyer when needed

Staying aligned with our internal systems, workflows, and campaign standards

Contributing useful observations when you notice patterns, risks, or opportunities in the accounts you manage



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, quality of execution, and your ability to think through the work strategically.



This role starts with a 30-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, responsiveness, and good decision-making, there will be room to discuss salary growth — especially if the campaigns you handle are performing well and you are adding real value to the team and our clients.



We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.



Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for people who can adapt, think clearly, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body:



Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your media buying experience.



To confirm availability, please close the recording by saying:

“I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Treasury Virtual Assistant (Finance & Cash Management)
description:
Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Treasury Virtual Assistant to support our finance department with daily treasury operations across multiple companies. This role requires a trustworthy professional with strong financial administration skills who can accurately manage banking activities, monitor cash positions, prepare payment requests, and maintain detailed financial records while following strict internal controls.



The ideal candidate has experience working with online banking platforms, accounting systems, and financial reporting. Confidentiality, accuracy, and professionalism are essential.



Key Responsibilities

Monitor daily bank account balances and cash positions.

Prepare payment requests for approval.

Process approved ACH, wire transfers, checks, and vendor payments.

Maintain a daily cash flow tracker.

Reconcile bank transactions with accounting records.

Review invoices and supporting documentation prior to payment.

Coordinate with Accounting, Operations, and Executive Leadership regarding payment schedules.

Track loan draws, capital expenditures (CapEx), and lender reimbursement requests.

Maintain treasury reports and banking records.

Assist with monthly bank reconciliations.

Monitor upcoming debt payments, vendor obligations, payroll funding, and recurring expenses.

Communicate with banks regarding treasury matters when authorized.

Ensure all treasury activities follow company policies and internal controls.

Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all financial information.

Support additional finance and administrative projects as assigned.

Requirements

Previous experience in Treasury, Accounting, Bookkeeping, Finance, or Banking.

Strong understanding of ACH, wire transfers, bank reconciliations, and cash management.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar accounting software is preferred.

Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication.

Ability to handle confidential financial information.

Reliable internet connection and dedicated home office.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.

Experience with commercial real estate, private equity, or multi-entity businesses is a plus.

Familiarity with lender draw requests, CapEx tracking, and treasury management.

Hours



40 hours per week (Full-Time)



Compensation



Competitive and based on experience.



Important: The Treasury Virtual Assistant will prepare and initiate payment requests; however, all outgoing ACH and wire transfers are subject to a dual-approval process. No single employee has independent authority to move company funds. This position requires strict adherence to internal financial controls, fraud prevention procedures, and confidentiality standards.



Top Skills

Treasury & Cash Management

Bookkeeping / Accounting

Microsoft Excel

Forecasting

The ability to learn new software

title: Senior Reporting Healthcare Analyst (Expert Excel Skills & dashboard skills required with good communication skills)

Design, build, and maintain complex Excel-based reporting systems (dashboards, automated trackers, linked workbooks)

Pull, clean, and analyze data from EHR/practice management systems

Develop monthly analytics on referral trends, clinician productivity, utilization review outcomes, and revenue performance

Track authorization statuses, session limits, and concurrent review deadlines to support timely utilization review submissions

Communicate directly with clinicians regarding their productivity and quality metrics, following up as needed to address gaps or trends

Identify data inconsistencies and recommend process improvements

Present findings in clear, digestible formats for clinical and administrative leadership

Maintain data integrity and confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA



Required Qualifications:



Expert-level Excel skills (VBA, Power Query, advanced formulas, dashboard design)

Demonstrated experience building complex, automated Excel systems (not just basic spreadsheets)

Meta Ads is the heart of this role, because it's what drives our sales. Alongside that, you'll help run the day-to-day e-commerce operation. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a winning campaign, digs into the data, and fixes what's not working before anyone asks, we want to hear from you.



What Makes You a Fit (most important first)

- Meta Ads mastery; this is our #1 requirement. You have hands-on experience setting up and running campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager: structuring campaigns, choosing and testing audiences, managing budgets, testing creatives, and scaling winning ad sets. You understand the numbers (CPC, CTR, cost per purchase) and know exactly when to scale and when to kill a campaign. You can point to real results.

- Truly independent. You can own the ads and the daily operation without being told every step. You spot problems and solve them proactively.

- Customer service: handling inbound
s, inquiries and disputes professionally

- Order & supply chain management: tracking orders, flagging issues, coordinating with suppliers

- Supplier communication in English

- Proactively building templates and SOPs where none exist yet

- Reporting via structured check-ins on Monday (week start) and Friday (week close)



Growth Path

- Now: full ownership of the ads and the daily operation.

- Performance-driven: as you prove yourself, your responsibility, hours, and pay grow with the business. No fixed timeline, growth is earned through results.

- The business is built to grow fast, and the right person grows with it, into more responsibility and, over time, an Operations Manager role.



Position Details

- Remote, long-term role

- Part-time to start, expanding based on performance

- Weekly check-ins: Monday and Friday

- A stable, reliable internet connection is required



How to Apply

Send a short introduction in English. Most importantly: tell me specifically about your Meta Ads experience — which stores you ran campaigns for, how you structured and scaled them, and what results you achieved. General "I can do everything" applications, or ones without concrete, hands-on Meta Ads experience, will not be considered. Show me you're the real deal.

title: Accommodation Coordinator — Close Deals Across Europe
description:
We are a fast-growing corporate housing broker placing employees from global companies into furnished apartments across Europe — Stockholm, Frankfurt, Aarhus, Rostock, Antwerp, and 50+ cities.



We get more live cases than we can close. That's why we're hiring.



This is not a call-center role. You will own real deals end-to-end and be treated like an operator, not a seat. If you're hungry and you can close, this is the fastest path we know to build a real career in European real estate and sales — from your laptop.



What you'll actually do

• Talk to real clients (HR leads, relocation managers, CEOs) and understand what they need

• Reach out to property owners across Europe — calls, WhatsApp, listings

• Negotiate and lock in a suitable apartment within 24–48 hours

• Become the expert on every property you present — know the exact number of rooms, square meters, floor, furniture, amenities, neighborhood, transit links, what's included, what's not. If a client asks "does it have a dishwasher?" you answer in 10 seconds without looking it up.

• Coordinate the booking through to check-in

• Own 10–15 live cases at any given time



How you get paid

• $40/week base ($160/month) to cover your time

• $15 commission per confirmed booking — uncapped

• Paid weekly, every Friday

• Our active coordinators close 5–10 bookings/month



The growth path is real

• Month 1: onboarding with our head coordinator. You shadow, then close supervised cases.

• Month 2–3: you run your own case load solo.

• After 15+ closed cases: promotion to Senior Coordinator — higher base, bigger commission, first pick of incoming cases.

• Top performers become Team Leads, managing new hires and earning on their closes too.



We already have three coordinators who started exactly where you would. One of them now leads the team.



You will fit if

• You like the phone and don't get nervous negotiating

• You can juggle 10–15 live cases without dropping balls

• You take initiative — we don't babysit

• Fluent, confident English

• You're hungry, ambitious, and want to get good at sales fast



Big plus: experience in real estate, travel, hospitality, sales, or B2B coordination.



What we give you

• A modern CRM built for this work

• AI assistants for research, outreach, and property matching

• A shared Slack team that actually helps each other close

• Direct access to the founder — no middle managers, no politics

• Clear career ladder, real ownership, real responsibility



How to apply

Send:

1. Short intro — who you are, where you are

2. Any experience with sales, calls, negotiation, or coordination

3. Why you believe you can close deals — not just "I'm hardworking"



Start your message with: READY TO CLOSE



Applications without those three words will be ignored — we only want people who can follow instructions.

title: 12 HR Decision | VA Remote Virtual Receptionist
description:
Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance. 



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.



To apply: Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly.



(1) Where in the Philippines are you currently located? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



(2) Please submit a screenshot of your internet speed and a few samples of your previous work output.  



(3) Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. 



(4) Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



(5) Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired.   



(6) Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, explain the exact step-by-step process you followed, the tools or systems used, and the typical result or output produced.



(7) If you were hired today, what are 3 specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Video Editor
description:
Looking for a fast, creative, and adaptable editor to work on high-energy fitness, lifestyle, and branded content. If you can’t handle fast turnarounds, intense edits, and storytelling-driven projects, this isn’t for you. 



You can find my page on Instagram and 
 Skills:

Fast-paced editing with dynamic transitions, masking & motion tracking

Strong storytelling structure (clean speech, no filler words, seamless scene flow)

Ability to match and enhance brand identity through editing

Colour grading, sound design, and motion graphics experience is a plus

BONUS: If you understand comedic timing, let me know!



The Role & Workload:

20+ edits/month (short & long-form) with 48-hour turnaround for short-form, 5 days for long-form

Opportunity to grow into a full-time role with regular projects

Collaborative and creative team culture.

Remote, flexible, but deadlines are tight



Are You the Right Fit? 



Answer These:

**NOTE: Applications without these questions will NOT be considered. Do not use Ai to answer these questions (we can tell).**



1. It is Monday morning. The Reel you cut and shipped on Friday has 12,000 views and a 17% retention rate — about half what your last five cuts did. I have not said anything. What do you do this week?

Your answer:



2. A Reel you cut goes live with a hard cut on the wrong frame, a typo in the captions, or the wrong aspect ratio. It has been live for four hours and has 10,000 views. I am offline. What do you do — in order — in the next 30 minutes?

Your answer:



3. You are handed 90 minutes of raw long-form footage. The conversation is dry, the lighting is okay, the audio is fine. Your job is to find and cut THREE Shorts from it that will hit 100,000+ views. Walk us through how you find the moments and how you cut them.

Your answer:



4. It is Tuesday. Our last four Shorts have all flatlined — under 5,000 views each. You have a clean schedule until Friday. You have noticed three formats, edits, or sounds that have been working on competitor accounts in the last 30 days. Which one do you steal, and how do you cut it for us so it does not feel forced or late?

Your answer:



5. It is 4 PM Friday. You have a Short that is 80% there — the cut works, the hook lands, but the captions need polish and there is one frame you would love to redo. Posting today rides an algorithm boost from a guest appearance the founder did this morning. Posting Monday gives you the weekend to perfect it but loses the news cycle. What do you do?

Your answer:



6. It is 11 AM Wednesday. Something has just happened in our space — a viral moment a smart editor could ride. We have raw footage from a recent shoot that could speak to it. I'm in meetings until 2 PM. What do you do between now and 2 PM?

Your answer:



7. It is Monday morning. I message you: "I want our next five Shorts to use [a specific style — a motion-graphics technique, a retention-edit pattern, a colour grade, anything] that you have never used before. Can you have one ready by Friday?" Walk us through your week, Monday morning to Friday delivery.

Your answer:



8. It is day 90 in this new role. I ask you: "What is the one thing you have changed about how we make shorts that is directly responsible for our growth this quarter?" What do you say?

Your answer:



9 Look at our last 10 published pieces of content (links provided separately). Pick the one you think is the worst and tell us — frame by frame if you have to — what is broken about it. Don't be polite. Be helpful.

Your answer:



10. It is 2 PM Wednesday. I message you: "Use this song for the next three Shorts — it's blowing up." You listen to it. It does not fit our brand and it is already six weeks past peak. I’m excited. What is the actual conversation you have, today, before you start cutting?

Your answer:

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Looking for a talented VA with past experience working for US based companies. We are seeking a long term employee that is good at problem solving. 



Your role would include: 



- Using the GoHighLevel CRM system to track and manage sales statistics

- Using quick books online to assign expenses and income to associated projects

- Using Canva to create and update pitch decks and ad creatives

- Using indeed to post ads and set interviews via phone call. 



Preferred Experience 



- Quick Books Online (Preferred)

- Canva (Preferred) 

- Google Sheets (Preferred)

- Fluent speaking and phone call communication in a professional setting (Preferred) 



Schedule 



- This schedule for this role is Mon-Thurs 8am-2pm CST. 



Benefits



- Bi-Weekly payment 

- Flexible time off if requested 

- Opportunity for growth with the company 



 If you feel you are right for the job, please put the following in your response: 



1. Past experience with Quickbooks Online, GoHighLevel, and Canva

2. A google drive audio link demonstrating your English proficiency and communication style. (2-3 sentences) 

3. Your favorite animal and why



Look forward to hearing from you and hope to work together soon.
